blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 Cybersecurity Benchmarks: DPDPA 2023, RBI IT Governance & SEBI CSCRF. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Multi-regulatory frameworks enforce operational resilience and heavy statutory penalties across India's digital ecosystem.

📌 **Core Policy Directives & Scope:**
**RBI Penalties:** RBI imposed **₹54.78 crore in penalties across 353 cases** in FY25 for IT/cybersecurity lapses.
**DPDPA 2023 Penalties:** Statutory penalties up to **₹250 crore** for security failures and **₹200 crore** for breach notification failures.

💰 **Financial Outlays & Operational Rules:**
**RBI IT Governance & 2FA:** IT Governance Directions (effective April 2024); Authentication Directions 2025 mandate **2FA with at least one dynamic factor** for domestic digital transactions.
**SEBI CSCRF 2024:** Applies to **22 types of regulated entities** across a **5-tier model** (exchanges, depositories, brokers, AMCs).
DPDPA penalty for security failure (up to ₹250 crore) vs breach notification failure (up to ₹200 crore).
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
